transcript: After learning about each of these different lifestyles and future societies, I chose moral commonwealth as my most preferred because I believe in having good morality and being honest and true. And I chose the religious utopia as my least preferred because I don't believe in the faith-based order and I think it can often be very restrictive and hard to follow.
